criteria.requirement: Exactly 43 logical building identities are present with no missing, orphaned, aliased, or fallback identity.
Each of the 43 identities has explicit city, neighborhood, and block payloads.
Each direction is independently authored; no runtime or pack transform rotates, mirrors, synthesizes, falls back, or aliases a sprite.
All 24 captures use the frozen layout, LOD, authored direction, center, overlay, and selection inputs.
Buildings read as distinct, coherent, materially rich four-view city-builder assets at literal game scale.
Silhouette, ground contact, frontage, pivot, and scale remain legible across city, neighborhood, block, regular, and 900x600 views.
No overlap, clipping, mixed-fidelity seam, transparent-edge artifact, or adjacent-lot collision is visible.
Selection, placement, diagnostic overlays, pointer input, keyboard input, and compact layout remain understandable.
Accessibility semantics, Full Keyboard Access, VoiceOver, and Reduce Motion remain usable on the same candidate.

stopConditions: candidate or renderer receipt is absent for a candidate-bound gate
fixture, camera, resource, or manifest identity drifts
a forbidden transform, alias, fallback, crop, overlap, or clipping defect is reproduced
author coaching or hidden state is requested
any subjective disposition is requested from this Luna packet
